title: 机票退改申请信息表
prompt: 我想申请机票退改，让我填写订单号、原航班、退改原因和期望的新日期，整理出需要提交的信息。
program:
root = Col([intro, formModule, caveat])
$orderNo = ""
$flightNo = ""
$reason = ""
$newDate = ""
$submitted = false
intro = Text("填写退改申请所需信息，点击“整理信息”后会生成本地汇总，不会提交真实申请。")
reasons = ["行程变更", "身体原因", "航班取消", "其他"]
orderClean = @Trim($orderNo)
flightClean = @Trim($flightNo)
reasonClean = @Trim($reason)
dateClean = @Trim($newDate)
missingOrder = orderClean == ""
missingFlight = flightClean == ""
missingReason = reasonClean == ""
missingDate = dateClean == ""
hasMissing = missingOrder || missingFlight || missingReason || missingDate
missingLabels = @Flatten([missingOrder ? ["订单号"] : [], missingFlight ? ["原航班"] : [], missingReason ? ["退改原因"] : [], missingDate ? ["期望新日期"] : []])
missingText = @Join(missingLabels, "、")
summaryBlock = Col([Row([Caption("订单号"), Spacer(), Text(orderClean, "sm", null, "medium")], 2), Divider(), Row([Caption("原航班"), Spacer(), Text(flightClean, "sm", null, "medium")], 2), Divider(), Row([Caption("退改原因"), Spacer(), Text(reasonClean, "sm", null, "medium")], 2), Divider(), Row([Caption("期望新日期"), Spacer(), Text(@FormatDate(dateClean, "long"), "sm", null, "medium")], 2)], 2)
summaryOrNull = ($submitted && !hasMissing) ? summaryBlock : null
fillSample = Button("填入示例数据", Action([@Set($submitted, false), @Set($orderNo, "FLI202506123456"), @Set($flightNo, "CA1835"), @Set($reason, "行程变更"), @Set($newDate, @AddDays(@Today(), 14))]), "ghost", null, "sm", "sparkles")
organize = Button("整理信息", @Set($submitted, true), "solid", null, "md", "list-checks")
formModule = TravelModule([Text("带 * 的字段为必填。", "sm", "muted"), FieldRow("订单号 *", [Input($orderNo, "订单号", "text", "如 FLI202506123456")]), FieldRow("原航班 *", [Input($flightNo, "原航班", "text", "如 CA1835")]), FieldRow("退改原因 *", [Select($reason, reasons, "退改原因", "请选择原因")]), FieldRow("期望新日期 *", [DatePicker($newDate, "期望新日期", @Today())]), $submitted && hasMissing ? Text("请先补齐：" + missingText, "sm", "danger") : null, summaryOrNull, Row([organize, fillSample], 2)], "form", "机票退改信息整理", "所有内容仅保存在当前页面，不提交真实退改申请。")
caveat = Text("示例数据仅用于演示整理流程。如需实际退改，请前往航司官方渠道并核对最新政策与费用。")
